LAME / lamejs

WASWAN uses LAME through lamejs by Alex Zhukov and contributors, derived from jump3r/libmp3lame. The encoder is a separate, unmodified readable file, version 1.2.1, under LGPL-3.0.

LAME project · Pinned lamejs source

  • Readable encoder
  • Corresponding JS/Java source and upstream build scripts
  • GNU LGPL v3 · GNU GPL v3
  • Original upstream notice · Provenance and replacement information

Encoding runs locally in a browser worker. Audio is not uploaded. You may inspect, modify and replace the separate encoder under its license.
